name: Cron Explain
summary: Explain a cron schedule field by field, and list its next runs.
description: Adds an Explain permission and an explain command. Type `/cron */15 9-17 * * 1-5` to see what each field means, or add a start time to list the next five runs, like `/cron 0 9 * * 1-5 @ 2026-01-02 09:00`. Times are UTC and the start is always given, so the answer never depends on a clock. Supports ranges, steps, lists, month and day names, and @daily style aliases.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Explain cron schedules
permissions.description: Explain cron expressions in this space.

extension_points.name: explain
extension_points.description: Explain a five-field cron expression, optionally with @ start time.
